purpose: Development-only closed-loop model-domain and integration diagnosis
input_whitelist: native next encoder q/v as labels

replay_accounting.fit_scope: Each seed independently fitted on its existing v2 calibration only; no grid search; ridge=0.01 reproduces P0=100I prior.
replay_accounting.evaluation_scope: Existing development trajectories only, observational replay; all are development diagnostics, including in-sample calibration scores.

rollout_interpretation: Every rolling window starts from logged native q/v, then free state prediction uses the recorded requested command sequence. Future recorded commands are diagnostic replay inputs, not a claim that a deployment controller knows future closed-loop actions. No simulator queries.
